highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 updates the bundled renderer to Chrome m153 with current upstream correctness fixes.
highlights_body: Linux applications that rely on implicit font fallback should review the changed fallback behavior before upgrading.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback may select a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort path, which can change fallback glyphs or text metrics. Use an explicit family and style, or bundle a typeface, when deterministic selection matters.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Chrome m153 and incorporates current upstream bug, correctness, and buffer upload fixes.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 opened the 4.153 line with the Chrome m153 rendering engine and its upstream fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2: Release Candidate 1 prepared the 4.153 line for release.

harfbuzz_summary: Improves HarfBuzzSharp native build diagnostics without changing its managed binding surface.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Preview 1 introduces the Chrome m153 rendering engine.
v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.body: It incorporates current upstream rendering fixes and updates Linux font fallback behavior.

v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Release Candidate 1 prepares the Chrome m153 release line.
